انتهبوا (form VIII)

# اُنْتُهِبُوا (untuhibū) /un.tu.hi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# اِنْتَهِبُوا (intahibū) /in.ta.hi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
